item.description: Aaron Allston’s legendary Strike Force returns alongside Champions 6E in new double deal

item.title: Watch the ‘One Piece’ season 2 trailer featuring Nico Robin and a first look at The Grand Line
item.description: A new trailer for Netflix's One Piece season two has just dropped, and we pick up with the Straw Hat Pirates as they begin an adventure on The Grand Line - with the much-awaited addition of Nico Robin to the fray.

item.title: Doncaster Racecourse to host return of Tabletop Gaming Live
item.description: Tabletop Gaming Live returns Feb 14-15, 2026, at Doncaster Racecourse. Features Hachette UK, Warlord Games, and live D&D with Matt Chapman.

item.title: Legacy of the Algox: Frosthaven’s next major update detailed
item.description: The Legacy of the Algox update for Frosthaven launches Jan 22, adding three new heroes, five bosses, and a new storyline to the digital RPG.

item.title: 10-year-old designer Palash Bhasin launches Ultramons board game
item.description: Eagle Fox Games releases Ultramons, a tactical monster-battling board game designed by 10-year-old Palash Bhasin. Discover the Kickstarter success story here.

item.title: Review: Brides of Dracula – Quickstart
item.description: Explore a narrative RPG of gothic horror and emancipation. In Brides of Dracula, you are not the hunter but the prey fighting to escape a toxic, eternal prison.

item.title: The giant Warwolf monster hurler
item.description: Discover the power of the Warwolf, history’s most formidable trebuchet, in this interactive simulator. Test your siege engineering skills by calculating the flight distance and squish penalty of iconic roleplaying game monsters.

item.title: MP3 co-inventor launches Okeanos Pro AR audio system
item.description: The Okeanos Pro from Brandenburg Labs uses AR to simulate 16 virtual loudspeakers for professional audio mixing and immersive environments.

item.title: Viva La Dirt League and Critical Role team up for Daggerheart: Azerim
item.description: Viva La Dirt League partners with Critical Role for Daggerheart: Azerim. The new actual play series features Baradun and the Dickheads facing a Void horror.

item.title: Check out the ‘Lone Wolf and Cub’ (and other manga classics) bundle from Humble
item.description: Dark Horse Comics have rereleased their popular Lone Wolf and Cub (and other manga classics) bundle for a limited time only
